description: Bump PRs for the tools and fonts in home/dot_config/mise/config.toml together with mise.lock (slice 6, 7), the yazi plugin commit in home/.chezmoiexternal.toml, the GitHub Actions and the validator pins in ci.yml (slice 7). apt key pins and scripts/tools.lock are not covered here.

customManagers.description: The yazi-rs/plugins commit of the chezmoi externals: a new commit on main opens a PR that changes the archive URL.
The renovate-config-validator version the CI job runs.
The node the CI job runs the validator with (mise exec).

packageRules.description: python: patches get their own PR. Otherwise Renovate groups them with the minor and proposes only the highest version, a gated minor, so a patch never arrives.
node: a new major only on approval through the Dependency Dashboard.
python: a minor breaks compiled packages like a major, so both only on approval.
The validator's node (ci.yml) stays on 24, the line the pinned renovate supports; mise's node in config.toml is not affected.
